title: Judge Gift Cards 2019: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Hanna was astounded. Mirri read every leaf and wisp of breeze like a book of ancient lore.
Hidden within the clicking, chittering swarm is a unique mind, still young, but growing more aware as time passes.
The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.
"The past does not determine our present."
Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?
